symbols.name: addBusinessDays
symbols.doc: Adds a number of Brazilian business days (dias úteis) to a date.

symbols.name: capitalize
symbols.doc: Capitalizes a given string according to the way a Brazilian name, company name or address is written, with no configuration needed: `"jose da silva"` becomes `"Jose da Silva"`, `"empresa ltda"` becomes `"Empresa LTDA"` and `"santana/rs"` becomes `"Santana/RS"`.

symbols.name: convertCurrencyToWords
symbols.doc: Formats a monetary amount in Brazilian Reais as its "por extenso" textual representation, the style used to write out the amount by hand on cheques and contracts, e.g. `1523.45` becomes `"mil quinhentos e vinte e três reais e quarenta e cinco centavos"`.

symbols.name: convertDateToWords
symbols.doc: Formats a date as its Brazilian Portuguese "por extenso" textual representation, e.g. `"01/01/2024"` becomes `"primeiro de janeiro de dois mil e vinte e quatro"`.

symbols.name: convertLicensePlateToMercosul
symbols.doc: Converts an old format Brazilian license plate ("LLLNNNN") to the Mercosul format ("LLLNLNN"), following the official conversion table: the digit in the 5th position (the 2nd digit of the 4 digit number) becomes a letter, `0` through `9` mapping to `A` through `J`, and every other character is kept as is.

symbols.name: convertNumberToWords
symbols.doc: Formats an integer as its Brazilian Portuguese cardinal number words ("por extenso"), e.g. `1235` becomes `"mil duzentos e trinta e cinco"`.

symbols.name: differenceInBusinessDays
symbols.doc: Counts the number of Brazilian business days (dias úteis) between two dates.

symbols.name: formatBoleto
symbols.doc: Formats a given value as a Brazilian boleto.

symbols.name: formatCaepf
symbols.doc: Formats a CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) number according to the usual mask.

symbols.name: formatCbo
symbols.doc: Formats a CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) code into the `NNNN-NN` mask the classification prints.

symbols.name: formatCei
symbols.doc: Formats a CEI (Cadastro Específico do INSS) number according to the usual "00.000.00000/00" mask, the one the reference implementations of the check digit agree on (the Receita Federal does not print it).

symbols.name: formatCep
symbols.doc: Formats a given value as a Brazilian postal code (CEP).

symbols.name: formatCEP
symbols.doc: Formats a CEP, the 1.x name of `formatCep`.

symbols.name: formatCertidao
symbols.doc: Formats the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into the printed mask of the norm, the 32 digits grouped as 6 2 2 4 1 5 3 7 2 and separated by spaces.

symbols.name: formatCest
symbols.doc: Formats a CEST (Código Especificador da Substituição Tributária) in the `NN.NNN.NN` form the annexes of Convênio ICMS 142/18 print: segment, item of the segment and specification of the item.

symbols.name: formatCfop
symbols.doc: Formats a CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações) code into the `N.NNN` form the annex prints.

symbols.name: formatCid10
symbols.doc: Formats a CID-10 (Classificação Internacional de Doenças, 10th revision) code the way it is printed: upper case, with a dot between the 3 character category and the fourth character of the subcategory.

symbols.name: formatCnae
symbols.doc: Formats a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code.

symbols.name: formatCnh
symbols.doc: Formats a Brazilian CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) number.

symbols.name: formatCno
symbols.doc: Formats a CNO (Cadastro Nacional de Obras) number according to the usual mask.

symbols.name: formatCnpj
symbols.doc: Formats a given CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) value according to the specified options.

symbols.name: formatCNPJ
symbols.doc: Formats a CNPJ, the 1.x name of `formatCnpj`.

symbols.name: formatCns
symbols.doc: Formats a CNS (Cartão Nacional de Saúde) number into the common display groups of 3-4-4-4 digits separated by spaces.

symbols.name: formatCpf
symbols.doc: Formats a given CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) value according to the Brazilian standard.

symbols.name: formatCPF
symbols.doc: Formats a CPF, the 1.x name of `formatCpf`.

symbols.name: formatCurrency
symbols.doc: Formats a given value as a currency string in Brazilian Real (BRL).

symbols.name: formatIban
symbols.doc: Formats an IBAN in the ISO 13616 print grouping, blocks of 4 characters, the presentation used on statements and bank forms.

symbols.name: formatIsbn
symbols.doc: Formats an ISBN-13 the way it is printed: its five elements separated by hyphens (`978-65-89999-01-0`), the lengths of the registration group and of the registrant taken from the ranges the International ISBN Agency publishes, as `getIsbnInfo` reads them.

symbols.name: formatLegalNature
symbols.doc: Formats a Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) code.

symbols.name: formatLicensePlate
symbols.doc: Formats a Brazilian license plate (placa de carro ou moto).

symbols.name: formatNbs
symbols.doc: Formats an NBS (Nomenclatura Brasileira de Serviços, Intangíveis e Outras Operações que Produzam Variações no Patrimônio) code into the `N.NNNN.NN.NN` mask the nomenclature prints.

symbols.name: formatNcm
symbols.doc: Formats a NCM (Nomenclatura Comum do Mercosul) code.

symbols.name: formatNfeKey
symbols.doc: Formats a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) into groups of 4 characters separated by spaces, the form every auxiliary document prints it in: the DANFE of the NF-e and the NFC-e, the DACTE of the CT-e, the CT-e OS and the GTV-e, the DAMDFE of the MDF-e, the DABPE of the BP-e, the DANF3E of the NF3e and the DANFE-COM of the NFCom.

symbols.name: formatPassport
symbols.doc: Formats a Brazilian passport number for display. Converts to uppercase and removes all non-alphanumeric characters.

symbols.name: formatPhone
symbols.doc: Formats a phone number according to Brazilian phone number patterns.

symbols.name: formatPis
symbols.doc: Formats a PIS (Programa de Integração Social) number according to the specified pattern.

symbols.name: formatProcessoJuridico
symbols.doc: Formats a legal process number (processo jurídico) according to a specific pattern.

symbols.name: formatSuframa
symbols.doc: Formats an Inscrição SUFRAMA with the `SS.NNNN.LLD` mask: sector of activity, sequential number, locality and check digit.

symbols.name: formatVoterId
symbols.doc: Formats a Brazilian voter id (título de eleitor) for display.

symbols.name: generateBoleto
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random Brazilian bank slip (boleto) number.

symbols.name: generateCep
symbols.doc: Generates a random Brazilian CEP (postal code).

symbols.name: generateCnh
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação, the Brazilian driver's license number).

symbols.name: generateCnpj
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica).

symbols.name: generateCNPJ
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random CNPJ, the 1.x name of `generateCnpj`.

symbols.name: generateCpf
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas).

symbols.name: generateCPF
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random CPF, the 1.x name of `generateCpf`.

symbols.name: generateLegalNature
symbols.doc: Generates a random valid Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) code.

symbols.name: generateLicensePlate
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random Brazilian license plate (placa de carro ou moto).

symbols.name: generatePassport
symbols.doc: Generates a random valid Brazilian passport number.

symbols.name: generatePhone
symbols.doc: Generates a random, structurally-valid Brazilian phone number (DDD + subscriber number, no formatting/mask applied, see `formatPhone` to format the result).

symbols.name: generatePis
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random Brazilian PIS (Programa de Integração Social) number.

symbols.name: generatePixPayload
symbols.doc: Generates the payload of a Pix BR Code, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola".

symbols.name: generateProcessoJuridico
symbols.doc: Generates a random valid Brazilian Processo Jurídico (court case) number, following the `NNNNNNNDDAAAAJTROOOO` layout of Resolução CNJ nº 65/2008.

symbols.name: generateRenavam
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random RENAVAM (Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores) number.

symbols.name: generateSuframa
symbols.doc: Generates a random Inscrição SUFRAMA with a valid check digit, for tests and fixtures.

symbols.name: generateVoterId
symbols.doc: Generates a valid random Brazilian voter id (título de eleitor).

symbols.name: getAddressInfoByCep
symbols.doc: Fetches address information for a given CEP using multiple providers simultaneously. Returns the result from the first provider that responds successfully.

symbols.name: getAreaCodeByMunicipalityCode
symbols.doc: Looks up the DDD (area code, the Código Nacional of the Plano Geral de Numeração) in force for a Brazilian municipality, given its 7 digit IBGE code.

symbols.name: getAreaCodeInfo
symbols.doc: Retrieves the state (and its region) a Brazilian DDD (area code) belongs to.

symbols.name: getAreaCodesByState
symbols.doc: Retrieves every DDD (area code) that serves a given Brazilian state, under the Plano Geral de Numeração.

symbols.name: getBankByCode
symbols.doc: Looks up a Brazilian bank by its compensation code (COMPE), published by Banco Central do Brasil in the STR (Sistema de Transferência de Reservas) participants list.

symbols.name: getBankByIspb
symbols.doc: Looks up a Brazilian bank by its ISPB (Identificador do Sistema de Pagamentos Brasileiro), the 8 digit code that identifies every participant of the SPB, published by Banco Central do Brasil in the STR (Sistema de Transferência de Reservas) participants list. Every SPB participant has an ISPB, but this dataset only carries the institutions that also have a COMPE code, so an ISPB whose institution has no COMPE code of its own returns `null`.

symbols.name: getBanks
symbols.doc: Returns every Brazilian bank with a compensation code (COMPE), published by Banco Central do Brasil in the STR (Sistema de Transferência de Reservas) participants list.

symbols.name: getBoletoInfo
symbols.doc: Extracts information from a Brazilian bank slip (boleto).

symbols.name: getCbo
symbols.doc: Looks a CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) code up in the official CBO 2002 table.

symbols.name: getCepInfoByAddress
symbols.doc: Looks every CEP of a Brazilian street up on the ViaCEP API. ViaCEP caps the list at 50 addresses, so a short street name that matches more streets returns only the first 50.

symbols.name: getCertidaoInfo
symbols.doc: Parses the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into its fields.

symbols.name: getCest
symbols.doc: Looks a CEST (Código Especificador da Substituição Tributária) up in the annexes of Convênio ICMS 142/18.

symbols.name: getCfop
symbols.doc: Looks a CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações) code up in the official table.

symbols.name: getCid10
symbols.doc: Looks a CID-10 (Classificação Estatística Internacional de Doenças e Problemas Relacionados à Saúde, 10th revision) code up in the Brazilian Portuguese tables DATASUS publishes.

symbols.name: getCities
symbols.doc: Returns a list of city names for a given Brazilian state, or all cities if no state is specified.

symbols.name: getClassTrib
symbols.doc: Looks a cClassTrib (Código de Classificação Tributária do IBS e da CBS) up in the official table, the code the field `cClassTrib` of the group `IBSCBS` carries next to the CST-IBS/CBS in the electronic fiscal documents of the tax reform (Lei Complementar nº 214/2025).

symbols.name: getCnae
symbols.doc: Looks a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code up in the official CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table, the current subclass revision of CNAE 2.0.

symbols.name: getCnpjInfo
symbols.doc: Parses a CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) into the fields the number encodes.

symbols.name: getCodeByMunicipalityName
symbols.doc: Looks up the 7 digit IBGE code of a Brazilian municipality by its name and the code of its state, in the offline IBGE "localidades" dataset.

symbols.name: getCpfInfo
symbols.doc: Reads the fields a CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) encodes: the 8 digit base, the Região Fiscal digit with the states it covers, and the 2 check digits.

symbols.name: getCstIbsCbs
symbols.doc: Looks a CST-IBS/CBS (Código de Situação Tributária do IBS e da CBS) up in the official table, the code the field `CST` of the group `IBSCBS` carries in the NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, NFS-e and the other electronic fiscal documents of the tax reform (Lei Complementar nº 214/2025).

symbols.name: getFormatLicensePlate
symbols.doc: Identifies the format of a Brazilian license plate (placa de carro ou moto).

symbols.name: getGtinInfo
symbols.doc: Parses a GTIN (Global Trade Item Number, the number under an EAN/UPC barcode) into its fields.

symbols.name: getHolidays
symbols.doc: Retrieves all Brazilian holidays for a given year.

symbols.name: getHolidays
symbols.doc: Retrieves all Brazilian holidays for a given year.

symbols.name: getIbanInfo
symbols.doc: Parses a Brazilian IBAN (International Bank Account Number) into its fields.

symbols.name: getIsbnInfo
symbols.doc: Splits a valid ISBN-13 into its elements, following the ranges the International ISBN Agency publishes: the GS1 prefix, the registration group, the registrant, the publication and the check digit.

symbols.name: getLegalNature
symbols.doc: Looks a Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) code up.

symbols.name: getLegalNatures
symbols.doc: Returns every Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) published by the CONCLA.

symbols.name: getLegalNaturesByCategory
symbols.doc: Retrieves every Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) of a CONCLA category.

symbols.name: getMunicipalities
symbols.doc: Returns Brazilian municipalities published by the IBGE, optionally filtered by state.

symbols.name: getMunicipalitiesByAreaCode
symbols.doc: Lists the Brazilian municipalities that dial a given DDD (area code, the Código Nacional of the Plano Geral de Numeração).

symbols.name: getMunicipality
symbols.doc: Looks a Brazilian municipality up by its IBGE code in the offline IBGE "localidades" dataset.

symbols.name: getMunicipality
symbols.doc: Looks a Brazilian municipality up by its IBGE code in the offline IBGE "localidades" dataset.

symbols.name: getMunicipality
symbols.doc: Looks a Brazilian municipality up by its IBGE code in the offline IBGE "localidades" dataset.

symbols.name: getMunicipalityByCode
symbols.doc: Looks up a Brazilian municipality by its 7 digit IBGE code, published by the IBGE.

symbols.name: getNbs
symbols.doc: Looks an NBS (Nomenclatura Brasileira de Serviços, Intangíveis e Outras Operações que Produzam Variações no Patrimônio) code up in the official NBS 2.0 table, the code the national NFS-e carries in `cNBS`.

symbols.name: getNfeKeyInfo
symbols.doc: Parses a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) into its fields.

symbols.name: getNfseKeyInfo
symbols.doc: Parses the access key (chave de acesso) of a national NFS-e, the Nota Fiscal de Serviço eletrônica of the Sistema Nacional NFS-e, into its fields.

symbols.name: getPixKeyInfo
symbols.doc: Identifies a Pix key and normalizes it to the canonical form the DICT expects inside a BR Code.

symbols.name: getPixPayloadInfo
symbols.doc: Parses a Pix BR Code payload, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola".

symbols.name: getProcessoJuridicoInfo
symbols.doc: Reads the fields of a Número Único de Processo (`NNNNNNN-DD.AAAA.J.TR.OOOO`) of Resolução CNJ nº 65/2008: the sequential number, the check digits, the year of filing, the segment of the Judiciary, the tribunal and the unit of origin.

symbols.name: getRegions
symbols.doc: Retrieves the five Brazilian regions (Grandes Regiões) with their code, name and IBGE identifier, in the order of that identifier: Norte (1), Nordeste (2), Sudeste (3), Sul (4) and Centro-Oeste (5). The `code` is the same `State["regionCode"]` every state carries.

symbols.name: getServiceItem
symbols.doc: Looks a subitem up in the service list annexed to the Lei Complementar 116/2003, the list of the services the ISS is levied on.

symbols.name: getStateByCep
symbols.doc: Retrieves the Brazilian state a CEP (postal code) belongs to, from the CEP ranges the Correios assign to each state. It runs offline: the answer comes from the range table, not from a CEP API, so it says which state owns the range and not whether the CEP is in use.

symbols.name: getStateByIbgeCode
symbols.doc: Retrieves the Brazilian state whose 2-digit IBGE code ("cUF", the Código da Unidade da Federação) matches the given value.

symbols.name: getStateCapital
symbols.doc: Retrieves the capital of a Brazilian state, as the same `{ code, name, stateCode }` that `getMunicipalityByCode` returns for it. The match is case-insensitive and ignores leading and trailing whitespace, like `getTimezoneByState`.

symbols.name: getStateCodeByName
symbols.doc: Retrieves the two-letter code (sigla) of a Brazilian state given its full name.

symbols.name: getStateNameByCode
symbols.doc: Retrieves the full name of a Brazilian state given its two-letter code (sigla).

symbols.name: getStates
symbols.doc: Retrieves a list of all Brazilian states with their codes and names.

symbols.name: getStatesByRegion
symbols.doc: Retrieves the Brazilian states of a region (Grande Região), given the region code the IBGE abbreviates it with: `"N"`, `"NE"`, `"SE"`, `"S"` or `"CO"`, the same `State["regionCode"]` every state carries. The match is case-insensitive and ignores leading and trailing whitespace. The states come sorted by name, the way `getStates` sorts them.

symbols.name: getTimezoneByState
symbols.doc: Retrieves the IANA time zone database name (tzdata zone) for a Brazilian state, chosen as the zone of the state capital. The match is case-insensitive and ignores leading/trailing whitespace.

symbols.name: getVoterIdInfo
symbols.doc: Reads the fields of a voter id (título de eleitor): the sequential number, the federative union code with the state it stands for, and the 2 check digits.

symbols.name: isBusinessDay
symbols.doc: Checks whether a given date is a Brazilian business day (dia útil).

symbols.name: isHoliday
symbols.doc: Checks whether a given date is a Brazilian holiday.

symbols.name: isValidBankAccount
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian bank account. The bank code must belong to the Banco Central do Brasil STR participants list, otherwise the account is rejected.

symbols.name: isValidBoleto
symbols.doc: Validates if a Brazilian bank slip (boleto) number is valid.

symbols.name: isValidCaepf
symbols.doc: Validates a CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) number.

symbols.name: isValidCbo
symbols.doc: Validates if a CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) code exists in the official CBO 2002 table.

symbols.name: isValidCei
symbols.doc: Validates a CEI (Cadastro Específico do INSS) number.

symbols.name: isValidCep
symbols.doc: Validates if a CEP (Brazilian postal code) is valid.

symbols.name: isValidCEP
symbols.doc: Checks whether a CEP is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidCep`.

symbols.name: isValidCertidao
symbols.doc: Validates the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil (nascimento, casamento, óbito and the other acts kept by a serventia de registro civil das pessoas naturais).

symbols.name: isValidCest
symbols.doc: Validates if a CEST (Código Especificador da Substituição Tributária) is listed in the annexes of Convênio ICMS 142/18.

symbols.name: isValidCfop
symbols.doc: Validates if a CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações) code exists in the official table.

symbols.name: isValidCid10
symbols.doc: Validates if a CID-10 (Classificação Internacional de Doenças, 10th revision) code exists in the Brazilian Portuguese tables DATASUS publishes.

symbols.name: isValidClassTrib
symbols.doc: Validates if a cClassTrib (Código de Classificação Tributária do IBS e da CBS) exists in the official table, the check behind the rejection 1023 "Classificação Tributária do IBS/CBS informada inexistente" of the NF-e.

symbols.name: isValidCnae
symbols.doc: Validates if a CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) subclass code exists in the official CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 table, the current subclass revision of CNAE 2.0.

symbols.name: isValidCnh
symbols.doc: Validates if a CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação, the Brazilian driver's license number) is valid.

symbols.name: isValidCno
symbols.doc: Validates a CNO (Cadastro Nacional de Obras) number, the registration of a construction work with the Receita Federal.

symbols.name: isValidCnpj
symbols.doc: Validates if a CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) is valid. Supports both numeric (version 1) and alphanumeric (version 2) CNPJ formats. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`, `/`) and whitespace around and between groups. Since July 2026 new CNPJs may be alphanumeric, which the default `version: 1` rejects: pass `version: 2` to accept them.

symbols.name: isValidCNPJ
symbols.doc: Checks whether a CNPJ is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidCnpj`.

symbols.name: isValidCns
symbols.doc: Validates a CNS (Cartão Nacional de Saúde) number, the unique identifier of a SUS (Sistema Único de Saúde) user, health professional or health facility.

symbols.name: isValidCpf
symbols.doc: Validates if a CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) is valid. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`) and whitespace around and between groups.

symbols.name: isValidCPF
symbols.doc: Checks whether a CPF is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidCpf`.

symbols.name: isValidCreditCard
symbols.doc: Validates a payment card number (crédito ou débito) using the Luhn algorithm.

symbols.name: isValidCsosn
symbols.doc: Validates if a CSOSN (Código de Situação da Operação no Simples Nacional) code is valid.

symbols.name: isValidCst
symbols.doc: Validates if a CST (Código de Situação Tributária) code is valid for a given tax.

symbols.name: isValidCstIbsCbs
symbols.doc: Validates if a CST-IBS/CBS (Código de Situação Tributária do IBS e da CBS) exists in the official table, the check behind the rejection 1020 "CST do IBS/CBS informado inexistente" of the NF-e.

symbols.name: isValidEmail
symbols.doc: Validates if an email address is valid.

symbols.name: isValidGtin
symbols.doc: Validates a GTIN (Global Trade Item Number, the number under an EAN/UPC barcode).

symbols.name: isValidIban
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian IBAN (International Bank Account Number).

symbols.name: isValidIe
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian state tax registration number (IE).

symbols.name: isValidIe
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian state tax registration number (IE).

symbols.name: isValidIE
symbols.doc: Checks whether a state registration (inscrição estadual) is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidIe`.

symbols.name: isValidIE
symbols.doc: Checks whether a state registration (inscrição estadual) is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidIe`.

symbols.name: isValidIsbn
symbols.doc: Validates if an ISBN-13 (International Standard Book Number) is valid. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`, `/`) and whitespace around the value and between two digits, alone or in a run.

symbols.name: isValidLandlinePhone
symbols.doc: Validates if a phone number is a valid Brazilian landline phone.

symbols.name: isValidLegalNature
symbols.doc: Validates if a Brazilian legal nature (natureza jurídica) code exists.

symbols.name: isValidLicensePlate
symbols.doc: Validates if a Brazilian license plate (placa de carro ou moto) is valid.

symbols.name: isValidMobilePhone
symbols.doc: Validates if a phone number is a valid Brazilian mobile phone.

symbols.name: isValidNbs
symbols.doc: Checks if a value is a code of the official NBS 2.0 table (Nomenclatura Brasileira de Serviços, Intangíveis e Outras Operações que Produzam Variações no Patrimônio), the code the national NFS-e carries in `cNBS`.

symbols.name: isValidNcm
symbols.doc: Validates if a NCM (Nomenclatura Comum do Mercosul) code exists in the official table.

symbols.name: isValidNfeKey
symbols.doc: Validates a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso).

symbols.name: isValidNfseKey
symbols.doc: Validates the access key (chave de acesso) of a national NFS-e, the Nota Fiscal de Serviço eletrônica of the Sistema Nacional NFS-e.

symbols.name: isValidPassport
symbols.doc: Checks if a Brazilian passport number is valid. To be considered valid, the sanitized input must contain exactly two alphabetical characters followed by exactly six numerical digits. The input is case-insensitive and any non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, dots, hyphens, etc.) are ignored, mirroring the sanitization performed by `formatPassport`/`parsePassport`. This function does not verify if the input is a real passport number, as there are no checksums for the Brazilian passport. A number is accepted for symmetry with `formatPassport`/`parsePassport` but is never valid: the decimal form of a number never starts with the two letters a passport number needs.

symbols.name: isValidPhone
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian phone number.

symbols.name: isValidPis
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian PIS (Programa de Integração Social) number. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`, `/`, `(`, `)`, `,`, `*`) and whitespace.

symbols.name: isValidPIS
symbols.doc: Checks whether a PIS/PASEP is valid, the 1.x name of `isValidPis`.

symbols.name: isValidPixKey
symbols.doc: Validates a Pix key (chave Pix) against the DICT key formats.

symbols.name: isValidPixPayload
symbols.doc: Validates a Pix BR Code payload, the string behind a Pix QR Code and behind "Pix copia e cola", against the Manual de Padrões para Iniciação do Pix and, where the manual is silent, the EMV® QRCPS-MPM it builds on.

symbols.name: isValidProcessoJuridico
symbols.doc: Validates a Brazilian Processo Jurídico (court case) number.

symbols.name: isValidRegistroProfissional
symbols.doc: Checks the structure of a professional council registration number (registro/inscrição profissional).

symbols.name: isValidRenavam
symbols.doc: Validates if a RENAVAM (Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores) is valid.

symbols.name: isValidServiceItem
symbols.doc: Checks if a value is a subitem in force of the service list annexed to the Lei Complementar 116/2003, the list of the services the ISS is levied on.

symbols.name: isValidServicePhone
symbols.doc: Validates if a phone number is a valid Brazilian service number.

symbols.name: isValidSuframa
symbols.doc: Validates an Inscrição SUFRAMA, the registration number the Superintendência da Zona Franca de Manaus gives to companies with tax incentives, carried by the `ISUF` field of the NF-e. Accepts the mask characters `isValidCpf` reads (whitespace, `.`, `-` and `/`, alone or in a run) between the fields of `SS.NNNN.LLD` (the check digit included, as in `20.5678.10-6`), and surrounding whitespace. Any other character, or a separator inside a field, makes the value invalid.

symbols.name: isValidVin
symbols.doc: Validates a VIN (Vehicle Identification Number / chassi).

symbols.name: isValidVoterId
symbols.doc: Validates if a Brazilian voter id (título de eleitor) is valid.

symbols.name: parseBoleto
symbols.doc: Removes boleto formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCaepf
symbols.doc: Removes CAEPF (Cadastro de Atividade Econômica da Pessoa Física) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCbo
symbols.doc: Removes CBO (Classificação Brasileira de Ocupações) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCei
symbols.doc: Removes CEI (Cadastro Específico do INSS) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCep
symbols.doc: Removes CEP formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCertidao
symbols.doc: Removes the formatting of the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCest
symbols.doc: Removes CEST (Código Especificador da Substituição Tributária) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCfop
symbols.doc: Removes CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCid10
symbols.doc: Removes CID-10 (Classificação Internacional de Doenças, 10th revision) formatting characters and returns the upper case code without the dot, the form the DATASUS tables store.

symbols.name: parseCnae
symbols.doc: Removes CNAE (Classificação Nacional de Atividades Econômicas) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCnh
symbols.doc: Removes CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCno
symbols.doc: Removes CNO (Cadastro Nacional de Obras) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCnpj
symbols.doc: Removes CNPJ formatting characters and returns a normalized value.

symbols.name: parseCns
symbols.doc: Removes CNS (Cartão Nacional de Saúde) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCpf
symbols.doc: Removes CPF formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseCurrency
symbols.doc: Parses a string representing Brazilian currency format into a number.

symbols.name: parseIban
symbols.doc: Removes IBAN formatting characters, uppercases the result and returns the compact IBAN.

symbols.name: parseIsbn
symbols.doc: Removes the hyphens and every other character that is not a digit from an ISBN-13, keeping at most its 13 digits.

symbols.name: parseLegalNature
symbols.doc: Removes legal nature (natureza jurídica) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseLicensePlate
symbols.doc: Removes license plate formatting characters and returns only uppercase alphanumerics.

symbols.name: parseNbs
symbols.doc: Removes NBS (Nomenclatura Brasileira de Serviços, Intangíveis e Outras Operações que Produzam Variações no Patrimônio) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseNcm
symbols.doc: Removes NCM (Nomenclatura Comum do Mercosul) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseNfeKey
symbols.doc: Removes the formatting of a DF-e (Documento Fiscal eletrônico) access key (chave de acesso) and returns only the characters of the key: digits, plus the letters of an alphanumeric CNPJ in positions 7 to 18, the only ones the key's schema type (`[0-9]{6}[0-9A-Z]{12}[0-9]{26}`) opens to letters. Those letters are kept upper cased, as `parseCnpj` does with `{ version: 2 }`; a letter anywhere else is dropped like any other character outside the key.

symbols.name: parseNfseKey
symbols.doc: Removes everything but the digits and the letters of an alphanumeric CNPJ from the access key (chave de acesso) of a national NFS-e.

symbols.name: parsePassport
symbols.doc: Removes non-alphanumeric characters from a passport number, uppercases it, and caps it to 8 characters.

symbols.name: parsePhone
symbols.doc: Removes phone formatting characters, returns only digits, and caps the result to 11 digits.

symbols.name: parsePis
symbols.doc: Removes PIS formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseProcessoJuridico
symbols.doc: Removes legal process formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: parseSuframa
symbols.doc: Removes Inscrição SUFRAMA formatting characters and returns only digits, the way the `ISUF` field of the NF-e expects them.

symbols.name: parseVoterId
symbols.doc: Removes voter id (título de eleitor) formatting characters and returns only digits.

symbols.name: removeAccents
symbols.doc: Removes diacritical marks (accents, tildes, cedillas) from a string, decomposing every accented character into its base letter plus combining marks (Unicode NFD) and then dropping every combining mark (Unicode general category M, so accents from any script).

symbols.name: subBusinessDays
symbols.doc: Subtracts a number of Brazilian business days (dias úteis) from a date.

symbols.name: toStandardSchema
symbols.doc: Wraps one of the `isValid*` utilities (or any function of the same shape) in a Standard Schema, so it plugs into whatever accepts the interface: react-hook-form's `standardSchemaResolver`, TanStack Form, tRPC, Hono and the rest, next to schemas made with Zod, Valibot or ArkType.
